expressions.cn: 解决问题 (jiě jué wèn tí)
开发 / 创新 (kāi fā / chuàng xīn)
数字化转型 (shù zì huà zhuǎn xíng)
用户友好 (yòng hù yǒu hǎo)
在线平台 / 系统 (zài xiàn píng tái / xì tǒng)

work.scenario: Our company needs to *update* our internal system to improve efficiency. We also need to train staff on the new *user-friendly online platform* to ensure a smooth *digital transformation*.

life.scenario: My phone app needs an *update*. If it doesn't work after that, I'll try to *troubleshoot* it myself or ask for help. I also want to learn how to *develop* a simple website.

tech.scenario: We are *developing* a new feature to make the software more *user-friendly*. If any bugs appear, our team will *troubleshoot* them immediately to ensure the *online platform* runs smoothly.
